hook: Qwen4-Max, Anthropic's IPO, Nvidia drama and AI champions
summary: Alibaba unveils Qwen4-Max, a 2.4T-parameter model with a 1M-token context, and Anthropic's IPO is reportedly about 7x oversubscribed.
Jensen Huang has reportedly discussed returning as Nvidia CEO, while SEBI plans AI disclosure and oversight rules for market firms.
And the Trump administration plans to name more than two dozen US AI firms national champions to help them compete abroad.

stories.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max flagship model
stories.summary: Alibaba released Qwen4-Max, a new flagship 2.4T-parameter Mixture of Experts model featuring a 1-million-token context window. The company states it beats Qwen3.8-Max using up to ~50% fewer tokens.
stories.why_it_matters: The release introduces a new high-capacity model with a large context window and improved token efficiency compared to the previous version.
source_titles: Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max, its new flagship 2.4T-parameter MoE model with a 1M-token context window, saying it beats Qwen3.8-Max with up to ~50% fewer tokens (Qwen)
Alibaba says new flagship AI model cuts task costs by 60% while tightening cyber guardrails

stories.line: Alibaba's Qwen4-Max arrives with 2.4 trillion parameters
stories.detail: 1M-token context; Alibaba claims it beats Qwen3.8-Max while spending up to half the tokens
stories.image_prompt: A vast glowing server hall with long rows of blinking racks, bathed in cool blue light, cinematic wide shot.
stories.anchor: Alibaba is swinging big. Its new model can take in a million tokens at once, and Alibaba says it does more with less.

stories.headline: Anthropic targets up to $90.4B in IPO and private placement
stories.summary: Anthropic's IPO is approximately 7x oversubscribed as the company and its backers seek to raise up to $90.4 billion via an IPO and private placement. The AI firm is targeting a fully diluted valuation of approximately $1.4 trillion.
stories.why_it_matters: This event represents the largest IPO of all time, drawing immense institutional demand and testing market appetite for AI frontier model makers.
source_titles: Sources: Anthropic's IPO is ~7x oversubscribed; Anthropic and some of its backers are seeking to raise up to $90.4B via the IPO and a separate private placement (Bloomberg)

stories.anchor: Turning to Wall Street. Anthropic's listing would be the biggest IPO ever, and big investors are lining up for a piece.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang discusses Nvidia CEO comeback as allies lobby for return
stories.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has reportedly discussed returning to lead the chipmaker with confidants, as allies form a lobbying effort for his reinstatement. Huang resigned following an investigation into personal relationships that involved an executive at Megaspeed.
stories.why_it_matters: The potential return of a long-standing CEO after a major governance and security scandal impacts leadership stability at the world's most valuable public chipmaker.
source_titles: Sources: Jensen Huang has discussed a comeback as Nvidia CEO with confidants, as allies form a "war room" to lobby for his return and seek White House support (Financial Times)

stories.headline: SEBI to issue guidelines for AI use and human oversight in capital markets
stories.summary: SEBI will soon issue guidelines requiring market firms to disclose AI usage and maintain human oversight over critical decisions, according to SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey. The upcoming framework aims to protect investors and maintain market integrity without compromising safety.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how financial regulators are moving to enforce accountability and transparency on AI tools used in trading and advisory services.
source_titles: SEBI will make market firms disclose AI use and keep humans in the loop, chairman says
SEBI to introduce new AI rules for stock market: Mandatory disclosures and human oversight planned
stories.line: SEBI readies AI rules for capital market firms
stories.detail: Firms must disclose AI use and keep people in charge of critical calls, says chair Tuhin Kanta Pandey

stories.anchor: Also tonight, regulators catch up. SEBI wants investors told when AI is involved — and a human signing off.

stories.headline: Trump administration plans to name AI "national champions"
stories.summary: The Trump administration plans to designate more than two dozen artificial intelligence companies, including Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Anthropic, as "national champions." The program is designed to help U.S. firms expand overseas and compete with Chinese rivals.
stories.why_it_matters: This policy establishes formal government backing for select U.S. technology firms to help them compete internationally.
source_titles: Sources: the Trump admin plans to name Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI, and Anthropic among 24+ AI "national champions" to help them win overseas business (Wall Street Journal)

stories.anchor: And finally, the White House is picking winners. The goal? Helping US AI firms beat Chinese rivals abroad.
